messages:
taylor: Quick check — onboarding LlamaX-7B done (weights in gs://rwd-weights/llamax/7b/v2). Tokenizer mapping looks OK but tokenizer adds <|bos|> and <|eos|> causing chat template to double-terminate. Anyone seen this with the new merges?

nina: thanks — can you paste the tokenizer.special_tokens list?

taylor: sure: `['<|bos|>','<|eos|>','<|pad|>','<|s|>']` — model.yaml currently has `preserve_bos: false` which might be trimming the prefix but leaves EOS intact.

kevin: hmm — on serving we expect the chat template to insert its own BOS; if tokenizer also emits one we get offset by 1 in kv-cache. That could explain small off-by-one in streaming start.

taylor: repro: short convo -> first token is duplicate `<|bos|>` and kv cache hit for position 0 shows repeated token id. log snippet:
```
kv_pos=[0,1,2]
tokens=[50256,50256,123,456]
```

tokenizer-ci: automated test flagged `chat_template_roundtrip` fail (diff at pos 0). Raising PR to add `normalize_special_tokens` step.

nina: quick mitigation — set `model.yaml: chat_template.strip_leading_bos: true` and add validation that tokenizer doesn't emit BOS when used in chat mode.

kevin: Can we add a config validator in model onboarding? e.g.,
```
if tokenizer.has_bos and chat_template.produces_bos:
    error("conflicting_bos_behavior")
```

taylor: yes — I'll put a small lint in onboarding script and ping infra for a canary deploy to run against LlamaX-7B.

deploy-bot: canary job queued: build-llamaX-7B-canary #452

nina: one more oddity — special token `<|s|>` collides with our sentinel in eval harness. Suggest renaming at mapping stage to `<|sent_s|>` or update harness.

kevin: agree. Also add a note to the release checklist: "validate tokenizer special token stable ids".

taylor: ok. I'll open two PRs: 1) onboarding lint, 2) chat_template flag + docs. ETA EOD.

nina: lgtm, leave a comment in the PR when ready — will review.

kevin: :thumbsup:

taylor: thanks — will update thread with canary results.
